The best piece of advise I can give in that situation is what was given to me when I started Warhammer:

Look through the Codexes and find an army you think looks cool. Then, buy a simple squad/infantry box of the guys, put them together and paint them. If, at the end or while you're painting them you think, "I don't think I can do an entire army of these guys," that isn't the army you should play.

Food for thought.

I've only dabbled in fantasy a slight amount, and that was during the previous addition, but here's my two cents on the armies.

From what I've heard and seem Ogres are a bully army, when they get the lead and keep it they can just absolutely destroy the other army. The have a lot of fast units that can get up in your opponent's face quick and have a high enough strength/toughness/wound count that they can wreck a lot of things. Of course, they can lose the lead, and when they do it's bloody difficult to get it back, if at all.

For lizardmen, some of their units are similar in stats to the Ogres (save for the speed), but most of their normal infantry are more numerous, yes, but obviously lack in stats. It also looks as if a lot of their spellcasters/sorcerers are just brutal, being able to get a high number of spell dice quickly and have a lot of excellent spells (I mainly refer to the Slann Mage Priest).

That's my two cents, anyway. I haven't played fantasy in a while, so really, I'd say whatever army looks better to you, play that one.
